name: B10-0334/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified soybean MON 87705 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission not to allow a type of genetically modified soybean into the EU market for food and feed. The soybean is engineered to survive spraying with two weedkillers, glyphosate and dicamba, and to have a changed fat profile. Parliament says this would mean more weedkiller use, harming biodiversity, soil, water and workers' health. It also says the EU's own rules and international promises were not properly respected. Parliament cannot block the decision itself; it is formally objecting and asking the Commission to withdraw its plan.

- Nothing changes yet: Parliament only objects and asks the Commission to withdraw its plan.
- It affects EU food and animal feed imports, farmers abroad, and public health.
- Next, the Commission decides whether to drop the plan or go ahead anyway.
